Notes: Generated by SilentScan.Verify generate-collation-codepages against the local Docker SQL Server, from sys.fn_helpcollations() joined to COLLATIONPROPERTY(name, 'CodePage'). Every entry is a non-Unicode code page (Windows codepage id, or 65001 for a _UTF8 collation) that char/varchar storage under that collation uses; it is what WriteLossClassifier checks a Unicode literal's characters against before claiming an implicit Unicode-to-non-Unicode write silently replaces them with '?'.
